provenance.method: Blind A/B grading. Per question the baseline and all-six answers were shown as system_A/system_B in a seeded random order; one grader agent per 10 questions graded both against the gold, and an independent skeptic agent re-checked every grade and could change it (1 of 110 changed). Labels mapped back afterwards.
